organization_note: SpaceX completed its acquisition of xAI on 2 February 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary, and xAI now calls itself SpaceXAI; its policies name SpaceXAI LLC. The catalog names the developer xAI or SpaceXAI (xAI) release by release and names the API operator xAI, so both names belong to this record.
